info.title: Slabswarm Trading Card Data Product API
info.description: First-party trading-card research and data product API. Raw evidence is immutable and corrections append. Simulations are hypotheses, never sales evidence. Basis is explicit (SOLD/ASKING/OFFER/GUIDE/CLAIM/POPULATION/UNKNOWN) and is never defaulted. Missing shipping, fees, FX, grade or condition is UNKNOWN, not zero. Every fact carries source, observed_at, captured_at, lineage and confidence. Deterministic code computes valuations and scores; models only propose, explain and challenge. Learning promotes only through benchmark gates.
